title: Pope Leo leaves hospital after cancer surgery
summary: Four days after undergoing surgery for lung cancer, Pope Leo left hospital in Rome. His doctors said he was well enough to return home.

image.caption: Leo XIV waved to well-wishers outside the hospitalImage: Tiziana Fabi/AFP

blocks.text: Pope Leo XIV left the Gemelli hospital in Rome on Saturday afternoon. He returned to the Vatican four days after undergoing surgery for lung cancer.
The 71-year-old pope walked unaided to his car and stopped to speak with well-wishers outside the hospital.
After conducting blood tests and imaging scans of his chest, the pope's doctors said he was well enough to return home.
